warnings.message: Same full target sentence is reused across multiple scored activities.

manualReview.scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0088; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: I leave at six/seven are natural short statements about departure time.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian preserves the depart sense of leave.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One lexical target is practiced with two time changes.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast the two target times and unrelated recent language.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Neighbors can naturally compare departure times for today and tomorrow.

difficultyFit.evidence: Short A1 time expressions and familiar syntax are used.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: The target progresses through recognition, guided exchange, transfer and retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: The transfer changes the departure time and day prompt.

overallCoherence.evidence: All lesson elements align on leave as depart.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded depart sense is reviewed.
Audio prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
resolvedFindings: Persian meaning and orthography are coherent.
